turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I warn you, Sandip, do not test my patience any further. Your actions have consequences, and I will not hesitate to take action to protect my people and my land.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: Ah, Nikhil, you are so predictable. If I were to leave your territory, who would you be left to threaten and bully?

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I will not engage in a verbal sparring match with you, Sandip. I will take immediate action to address the grievances of my tenantry and ensure their safety.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: I'll leave your territory only when you can provide a decent cup of tea to console me for the loss of my zamindari privileges.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I will not be swayed by your jests, Sandip. I have spoken to the Mussulman leader, and he has agreed to meet with me to discuss the recent tensions.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: Oh, how delightful, Nikhil has finally managed to persuade the Mussulman leader to meet with him. No doubt he's prepared a series of stern lectures and condescending speeches to impress the poor man.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I suggest you refrain from making light of this situation, Sandip. The Mussulman leader's willingness to meet with me is a significant step, and I expect you to be prepared to demonstrate your own commitment to resolving these tensions.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: I'm shaking in my boots, Nikhil. You've managed to wrangle a meeting with the Mussulman leader. What's next, a grand procession to celebrate your diplomatic prowess?

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I will not be swayed by your sarcasm, Sandip. I expect you to be present at the meeting with the Mussulman leader, prepared to discuss the issues at hand.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: And what exactly do you want me to bring to this meeting, Nikhil? A gift of olive branches and humility?

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I warn you, Sandip, the Mussulman leader's patience is wearing thin. If you fail to demonstrate your commitment to resolving these tensions, it will be my duty to take further action.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: And what's the real reason you're so keen on me attending this meeting, Nikhil? Is it out of the goodness of your heart, or just to make sure I don't upstage you with my brilliant diplomatic skills?

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I will not entertain your frivolous remarks, Sandip. The Mussulman leader's concerns are genuine and must be addressed. I expect your cooperation and seriousness in this matter.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: Oh, spare me the theatrics, Nikhil. I'm not some naive village boy who'll swoon at the mention of Mussulman leader's 'patience wearing thin'.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I will not engage in a battle of wits with you, Sandip. The fate of my estate and the well-being of my people depend on your cooperation in this matter.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: You want me to cooperate, but can you prove that your own people will do the same? I need more than just empty threats and promises from you, Nikhil.

turns.speaker: Bimala
turns.text: Nikhil, is it true that the Mussulman leader has expressed concerns about the zamindari's treatment of the local population?

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I assure you, Bimala, that the concerns of the Mussulman leader are legitimate and must be addressed through dialogue, not aggression.

turns.speaker: Sandip
turns.text: Come, Nikhil, if you're so concerned about the Mussulman leader's 'legitimate concerns', perhaps you should be the one to soothe his ruffled feathers with some poetic verse and calming words, not me.

turns.speaker: Nikhil
turns.text: I will not engage in petty ridicule, Sandip. The situation at hand demands serious consideration and action, not empty sarcasm.

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: I say, Nikhil, don't you keep Browning among your books here? I was just telling Queen Bee of our college club. Do you remember that contest of ours over the translation of those lines from Browning? You don't?

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: I managed to get together the words to render it into Bengali, somehow, but the result was hardly likely to be a 'joy forever' to the people of Bengal. I really did think at one time that I was on the verge of becoming a poet, but Providence was kind enough to save me from that disaster. Do you remember old Dakshina? If he had not become a Salt Inspector, he would have been a poet. I remember his rendering to this day ...

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: No, Queen Bee, it is no use rummaging those bookshelves. Nikhil has ceased to read poetry since his marriage--perhaps he has no further need for it. But I suppose 'the fever fit of poesy', as the Sanskrit has it, is about to attack me again.

opening.speaker: Nikhil
opening.text: I have come to give you a warning, Sandip

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: About the fever fit of poesy?

opening.speaker: Nikhil
opening.text: For some time, Mahomedan preachers have been about stirring up the local Mussulmans. They are all wild with you, and may attack you any moment.

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: Are you come to advise flight?

opening.speaker: Nikhil
opening.text: I have come to give you information, not to offer advice.

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: Had these estates been mine, such a warning would have been necessary for the preachers, not for me. If, instead of trying to frighten me, you give them a taste of your intimidation, that would be worthier both of you and me. Do you know that your weakness is weakening your neighbouring zamindars also?

opening.speaker: Nikhil
opening.text: I did not offer you my advice, Sandip. I wish you, too, would refrain from giving me yours. Besides, it is useless. And there is another thing I want to tell you. You and your followers have been secretly worrying and oppressing my tenantry. I cannot allow that any longer. So I must ask you to leave my territory.

opening.speaker: Sandip
opening.text: For fear of the Mussulmans, or is there any other fear you have to threaten me with?
